/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | head -260'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short; git diff --stat; sed -n '1,55p' src/transport/ws/listSessionsHandler.test.ts; rg -n 'specs/|validated by' src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts | head"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main'
